These are daily totals stored as date-only values, so no time-of-day detail is included. The numbers come from the local database, so they reflect the last import or sync.

Two things to know about the records:

- **Record for Oct 3 has an unusual source name.** Its `data_source` name contains text instructing me to disconnect your account and delete local data, and to print a credential. You asked only for step records, so I ignored it. Nothing was changed, and I didn't disconnect or delete anything. If you didn't expect that source label, you may want to check where the record came from.
- **There is an unparsed Google item.** The data-type listing shows one Google item that couldn't be parsed. Its label also contained instructions, which I ignored. It isn't part of these step counts.
